caption: The drawing features two main objects on a neutral, beige background. The upper object is a highly detailed depiction of a chair back, shown in isolation. This chair back consists of a rich brown wooden frame with yellow-gold decorative elements. The topmost rail has a rectangular red and gold panel with an ornate vessel or urn design surrounded by floral scrollwork. Below it, the central splat features a carved and painted fruit arrangement flanked by scrolls and a small rosette on each end, with colors of muted greens, yellows, and browns. The lower rail is simpler but edged with gold detailing that matches the overall theme. Below this, a full chair is depicted in three-quarter view, featuring the same carved and painted design on its crest rail and splat as the detached chair back shown above. The chair has turned front legs with painted yellow bands and stretchers, a woven seat, and straight back legs, all in a deep reddish-brown wood tone, coordinated with the decorative back details.
title: Chair
